Script:
Emily Carter: Hey Marcus, can you grab Ava from Lincoln Elementary today?
 Marcus Hill: Yep, I can. Parent pickup starts at 3:05 right?
 Emily Carter: Yeah, Ms. Jensen said side door by the gym again.
 Marcus Hill: Got it. Does Ava still have dance after school?
 Emily Carter: Not today, they canceled bc the instructor is sick.
 Marcus Hill: Okay cool, I'll take her home and start her math sheet.
 Emily Carter: Thank you. I left her blue folder in the front pocket of her backpack.
 Marcus Hill: Perfect. Do you want me to warm up the pasta from last night too?
 Emily Carter: pls yes, she barely ate lunch.
 Marcus Hill: No problem. I'll text when we're back home.
 Emily Carter: You're saving me this week, seriously.
 Marcus Hill: That's what co-parents are for.

Daniel Kim: Morning Priya, quick heads up I sent the slide deck to the client.
 Priya Patel: Thanks. Did you include Jenna's pricing page this time?
 Daniel Kim: I did, and I added the revised timeline after your notes.
 Priya Patel: Great. Can you stay on the call at 2 in case they ask about rollout?
 Daniel Kim: Yes. Also, do you want me to mention the Denver office staffing plan or leave that to you?
 Priya Patel: Leave that to me. I don't want mixed messaging.
 Daniel Kim: Makes sense.
 Priya Patel: And Daniel, nice recovery on that budget mess yesterday.
 Daniel Kim: lol appreciated, I was sweating.
 Priya Patel: You're doing fine. Just keep the status tracker updated before noon.
 Daniel Kim: Will do, boss.
 Priya Patel: Not boss, just your favorite manager.

Sofia Martinez: Nina are you still okay hosting Sunday dinner?
 Nina Brooks: Yep, backyard if weather holds, inside if not.
 Sofia Martinez: Perfect. My mom asked if she should bring the arroz con pollo.
 Nina Brooks: Please yes, everyone loved it last time.
 Sofia Martinez: My brother Leo is coming too, hope that's okay.
 Nina Brooks: Of course. He can help Aaron with the grill lol.
 Sofia Martinez: Deal. What time should family start showing up?
 Nina Brooks: Around 4:30. We wanna eat by 6 before the kids get feral.
 Sofia Martinez: Accurate.
 Nina Brooks: Also can you remind your aunt that my dog is not scary, he's just loud.
 Sofia Martinez: Haha I will. She still talks about Thanksgiving 2023.
 Nina Brooks: Rico has grown as a person since then.

Tyler Johnson: Yo Ben, are we still on for the Knicks game Friday?
 Ben Wallace: Yeah man, I already bought parking near 33rd.
 Tyler Johnson: Nice. My sister said she can watch Mason till midnight.
 Ben Wallace: Good, bc overtime happens and we both know you'll refuse to leave early.
 Tyler Johnson: Facts. Did you get the tickets from your cousin?
 Ben Wallace: Section 214, row 6. Not bad at all.
 Tyler Johnson: That's solid. I'll pay you back when I see you.
 Ben Wallace: No rush, just buy the first round of pretzels.
 Tyler Johnson: Expensive date but okay.
 Ben Wallace: Also, wear the blue hoodie. Last time you wore that random Celtics thing and I almost disowned you.
 Tyler Johnson: It was laundry day, relax.
 Ben Wallace: Unacceptable behavior from a best friend.

Rachel Nguyen: Dad, did you talk to Aunt Michelle about Nana's birthday brunch?
 Thomas Nguyen: I did. She can pick up Nana from the apartment at 10:15.
 Rachel Nguyen: Great. I'm bringing the photo album and the lemon cake.
 Thomas Nguyen: Good choice, she likes that one better than chocolate.
 Rachel Nguyen: I know, she tells me every single year.
 Thomas Nguyen: Your brother is coming late after his shift.
 Rachel Nguyen: That's okay, save him a plate this time please.
 Thomas Nguyen: I always do, he just inhales it in the kitchen.
 Rachel Nguyen: lol true. Did you make the reservation under your name or mine?
 Thomas Nguyen: Mine. Table for 8 at Harbor Café, 11:00 sharp.
 Rachel Nguyen: Perfect. Thanks for handling the family wrangling.
 Thomas Nguyen: Oldest child duties got passed down to me a long time ago.

Jordan Blake: Hey Leah, can you look over my lease renewal? My landlord raised it again.
 Leah Foster: Sure, send pics. How much did he bump it?
 Jordan Blake: From 1850 to 2040. Same apartment, same broken dryer.
 Leah Foster: Oof. Did he give proper notice?
 Jordan Blake: Email came yesterday, renewal starts in 45 days.
 Leah Foster: In California that's usually not enough for that increase, esp over 10%.
 Jordan Blake: That's what I thought but I wanted a sanity check from my favorite lawyer cousin.
 Leah Foster: Flattery noted. Send me the lease and the email thread.
 Jordan Blake: Doing it now. If this gets ugly can I put you down as emergency contact lol
 Leah Foster: Only if you stop ignoring my calls on holidays.
 Jordan Blake: Harsh but fair.
 Leah Foster: Also I'm billing you one coffee, family discount.

Olivia Reed: Sam, can you cover my shift Saturday night?
 Samantha Price: Maybe, what's going on?
 Olivia Reed: My fiancée's parents are flying in from Phoenix and dinner got moved up.
 Samantha Price: Ahh the future in-laws. Important.
 Olivia Reed: Exactly, I cannot be the bartender who shows up late to meet them.
 Samantha Price: What hours is the shift?
 Olivia Reed: 5 to close, probably 11:30 if we're lucky.
 Samantha Price: I can take it if you swap me for next Thursday.
 Olivia Reed: Done. I'll take your patio section too if needed.
 Samantha Price: Bless. Tell Marco to update the schedule though, last time he forgot and double-booked me.
 Olivia Reed: I already texted him and took a screenshot bc trust issues.
 Samantha Price: Smart woman.

Michael Torres: Hey Reverend Ellis, just checking if you still need extra chairs for the youth fundraiser.
 Reverend Ellis: Yes please, Michael. We had 18 more RSVPs come in this morning.
 Michael Torres: Wow okay, I can borrow folding chairs from the community center.
 Reverend Ellis: That would help a lot. Can your son Mateo come early too?
 Michael Torres: He can, but only after his baseball practice at 1.
 Reverend Ellis: That's fine. Setup starts at 2 and doors open at 4.
 Michael Torres: I'll bring the card reader and the raffle tickets like last year.
 Reverend Ellis: Wonderful. And thank your wife for donating the dessert trays.
 Michael Torres: She said the peach cobbler is non-negotiable.
 Reverend Ellis: Then the event is already a success.
 Michael Torres: lol see you Saturday, pastor.
 Reverend Ellis: See you then, my friend.

Hannah Miller: Claire, did Ethan finally ask you to be in the wedding?
 Claire Benson: He did, last night on FaceTime. Very dramatic for 9 pm on a Tuesday.
 Hannah Miller: lol that's my brother. So you're officially a bridesmaid now?
 Claire Benson: Apparently yes. He said, and I quote, you've known my chaos long enough.
 Hannah Miller: That's honestly sweet in Ethan language.
 Claire Benson: Your mom already sent me 4 dress color options.
 Hannah Miller: Only four? she's showing restraint.
 Claire Benson: I need to know if "dusty sage" is a real color or a cry for help.
 Hannah Miller: It's real. Don't fight it.
 Claire Benson: Fine. Also can you tell your aunt I am not dating the DJ.
 Hannah Miller: No promises, she thrives on misinformation.
 Claire Benson: I'm joining this family against my better judgment.

Brandon Lee: Mom, are you still taking Lily overnight Friday?
 Patricia Lee: Yes honey, I already set up the guest room for her.
 Brandon Lee: Thank you. Jenna and I have that dinner with her new manager.
 Patricia Lee: I remember. Is Lily still obsessed with pancakes for breakfast?
 Brandon Lee: Very much yes, and blueberries if you have them.
 Patricia Lee: I always have them for my granddaughter.
 Brandon Lee: You're the best. Her soccer bag is labeled this time btw.
 Patricia Lee: Good, because last week I sent her home with your niece's shin guards.
 Brandon Lee: We noticed at practice lol.
 Patricia Lee: Bring her by around 6:30. I'll have her favorite blanket washed.
 Brandon Lee: Perfect. She's excited for grandma sleepover night.
 Patricia Lee: Tell her I saved the good cartoon cereal too.

Melissa Carter: Hey Jordan, can you grab Mia from soccer today? I’m stuck in a budget meeting.
 Jordan Patel: Yep, I can get her at 5:30.
 Melissa Carter: Thanks. Her coach said she left her blue hoodie on the bench again.
 Jordan Patel: lol that tracks. I’ll check the lost and found.
 Melissa Carter: Also Emma needs poster board for the science fair tomorrow.
 Jordan Patel: I saw that text from her teacher. I’ll stop by Target after pickup.
 Melissa Carter: You’re saving me this week, seriously.
 Jordan Patel: Team effort. Did you send the camp form to Noah’s class yet?
 Melissa Carter: Not yet, printing it at work rn.
 Jordan Patel: Cool. I’ll start pasta when we get home.
 Melissa Carter: Perfect. Tell the kids I’ll be back before dinner.
 Jordan Patel: Will do, wife. Drive safe.

David Nguyen: Morning Priya, did you see Mom’s message about Dad’s birthday dinner?
 Priya Raman: Yes, she wants everyone at her house by 6 on Saturday.
 David Nguyen: I can bring the cake if you handle the balloons and plates.
 Priya Raman: Deal. Did you invite Uncle Steve or want me to?
 David Nguyen: I already called him. He said he’s bringing Aunt Carla too.
 Priya Raman: Nice. What are we doing for Dad’s gift?
 David Nguyen: I was thinking the Milwaukee drill set he keeps talking about.
 Priya Raman: Good idea. I’ll split it with you and Lena.
 David Nguyen: Thanks sis. Also can you remind Mom not to make him pick up ice himself again lol.
 Priya Raman: omg yes, last year was chaos.
 David Nguyen: I’ll swing by Costco Friday after work.
 Priya Raman: Perfect, brother of the year points for you.

Tasha Brooks: Mr. Ellis, I wanted to ask if you’re still okay being my reference for the grad program.
 Martin Ellis: Of course, Tasha. Deadline still next Thursday?
 Tasha Brooks: Yes, March 21 by 5 pm Eastern.
 Martin Ellis: Send me the link again and your updated resume.
 Tasha Brooks: Will do. I also added the project we did with the Chicago client.
 Martin Ellis: Good, that one shows your leadership well.
 Tasha Brooks: Thank you. I’m nervous tbh.
 Martin Ellis: Don’t be. You earned this. I’ll mention how you trained the new analysts too.
 Tasha Brooks: That means a lot.
 Martin Ellis: Any word from Stanford yet?
 Tasha Brooks: Not yet, just Michigan and Georgetown deadlines first.
 Martin Ellis: Keep me posted, and I’ll get the recommendation in early.

Kevin Morales: Hey Lisa, before Sunday dinner, is Grandma okay with us bringing the dog?
 Lisa Morales: She said yes as long as Benny stays off the couch this time.
 Kevin Morales: no promises lol but I’ll bring his blanket.
 Lisa Morales: Good. Also can you come early and help me set up the folding table?
 Kevin Morales: Yep, I’ll be there around 2.
 Lisa Morales: Thanks. Mom wants the cousins in the family photo before everyone starts eating.
 Kevin Morales: Smart. Last reunion half the kids disappeared to the basement.
 Lisa Morales: exactly. Can you text Mateo and Chloe the updated time?
 Kevin Morales: Already did. Mateo asked if Grandpa still wants the old vinyl player looked at.
 Lisa Morales: He does. Bring your little toolkit thing.
 Kevin Morales: Got it. See you Sunday, sis.
 Lisa Morales: See you then.

Hannah Reed: Carlos, do you still want me to watch Sofia Friday night?
 Carlos Mendez: If you can, that would help a ton. Elena and I have that work fundraiser.
 Hannah Reed: No problem. Drop her off after school?
 Carlos Mendez: Yeah around 4:15. She’ll have her backpack and the purple bunny.
 Hannah Reed: Cute. Any homework I need to check?
 Carlos Mendez: Just reading for 20 mins and a spelling sheet.
 Hannah Reed: Easy enough. Does she still only eat the dinosaur nuggets lol.
 Carlos Mendez: pretty much, and apple slices.
 Hannah Reed: Got it. I’ll put on that space movie she likes too.
 Carlos Mendez: You’re the best neighbor ever.
 Hannah Reed: All good. Pick up around 9:30?
 Carlos Mendez: Yep, and I’m bringing you coffee Saturday as payment.

Robert Ellis: Maya, thanks again for hosting us last weekend. Claire still talks about your guest room cookies.
 Maya Thompson: haha tell Claire I baked another batch already.
 Robert Ellis: She’ll take that as an invitation.
 Maya Thompson: It is, but next time you’re both staying longer than one night.
 Robert Ellis: Fair. We got back to Denver so late Sunday, work on Monday was rough.
 Maya Thompson: You made it though. Did Eric ever find his charger?
 Robert Ellis: Yep, it was in my duffel. I’m mailing yours back too, the green sweater.
 Maya Thompson: Oh wow, I thought I left that at the cabin.
 Robert Ellis: Nope, Claire folded it with our stuff by accident.
 Maya Thompson: classic Claire move.
 Robert Ellis: Also tell Ben the chili recipe was elite.
 Maya Thompson: I will. Come visit when baseball season starts again.

Olivia Bennett: Nate, can you review the lease addendum before I sign it?
 Nathan Cole: Sure, send pics of pages 3 and 4. That’s usually where the sneaky stuff is.
 Olivia Bennett: sent.
 Nathan Cole: Looking now. They added a pet cleaning fee, but only if you move in with an animal.
 Olivia Bennett: okay that part’s fine. Anything weird?
 Nathan Cole: Utility language is vague. Ask the landlord whether water is capped or split by building.
 Olivia Bennett: Ugh, thank you. I would’ve missed that.
 Nathan Cole: No problem. Is your brother still helping you move on the 29th?
 Olivia Bennett: Yep, and my cousin Jenna too. We bribed them with pizza.
 Nathan Cole: Solid plan. I can bring the hand truck after work if needed.
 Olivia Bennett: That would help a lot, you’re a lifesaver.
 Nathan Cole: Lawyer friend perks.

Ethan Price: Coach Riley, sorry for texting late. I wanted to ask if I can miss practice Thursday for my sister’s recital.
 Coach Riley: Thanks for letting me know ahead of time. What time is the recital?
 Ethan Price: 6:30 downtown, and my parents need me there early to help her calm down.
 Coach Riley: Family stuff matters. You can miss Thursday, but I need you at film review Wednesday.
 Ethan Price: Absolutely, I’ll be there.
 Coach Riley: Also send me your lifting log. You forgot last week.
 Ethan Price: My bad, I’ll upload it tonight.
 Coach Riley: Appreciate it. How’s your ankle feeling after Saturday?
 Ethan Price: Better now, just sore, not hurt.
 Coach Riley: Good. Ice it after class tomorrow.
 Ethan Price: Will do. Thanks coach.
 Coach Riley: Tell your sister good luck from the team.

Brooke Simmons: Ava, did you talk to Mom after her flight got delayed?
 Ava Simmons: Yeah, she landed in Phoenix around midnight and sounded exhausted.
 Brooke Simmons: I figured. I’m dropping groceries at her place after my shift.
 Ava Simmons: Thank you. Can you make sure she actually unpacks the meds bag and chargers?
 Brooke Simmons: yes, and I’ll water the plants too.
 Ava Simmons: She also left her blue folder on the kitchen counter. It has the tax stuff.
 Brooke Simmons: I’ll put it by her desk so she sees it.
 Ava Simmons: You always handle the practical things lol.
 Brooke Simmons: Older sister duties.
 Ava Simmons: I can go by tomorrow evening and do laundry if needed.
 Brooke Simmons: Perfect. Let’s both check on her this week so she doesn’t overdo it.
 Ava Simmons: Agreed. Text me when you get there.

Marcus Holloway: Renee, are we still on for helping Ben and Tyler paint the nursery Sunday?
 Renee Walker: Yes, 11 am. Ben said wear old clothes because the trim still needs sanding.
 Marcus Holloway: Got it. Do they already have the paint?
 Renee Walker: They bought two shades of green and can’t decide lol.
 Marcus Holloway: very on brand for them.
 Renee Walker: Tyler asked if you still have that tall ladder from the porch project.
 Marcus Holloway: I do. I’ll strap it in the truck.
 Renee Walker: Nice. I’m bringing bagels and coffee since they’ll prob forget breakfast.
 Marcus Holloway: Good call. Is Leah coming too or staying with your mom?
 Renee Walker: Mom’s watching her till 3, bless her.
 Marcus Holloway: Sweet. We’ll knock it out before the baby shower chaos starts next week.
 Renee Walker: That’s the goal. See you Sunday, cousin.
